name: Blankslate
statusNote: Draft and exported from @primer/react/experimental: the API may change without a major release. GitHub uses it widely for empty states; the visuals are stable.
summary: A centred empty state: an optional muted icon, a heading, a muted description and up to two actions (a primary Button and a secondary Link). Use it where a list, table or page has nothing to show yet, or to explain a missing feature; it is not a message about an event (use Banner).

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Type scale and padding; small also caps the visual at 24px and makes the primary action a small Button.

inputs.name: border
inputs.description: Draw a 1px default border with a medium radius.

inputs.name: narrow
inputs.description: Cap the width at 485px and centre the block horizontally.

inputs.name: spacious
inputs.description: More padding: 80px block and 40px inline (44px and 28px at small).

inputs.name: visual
inputs.description: Blankslate.Visual: an icon or illustration above the heading, in --fgColor-muted.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: The heading element (Blankslate.Heading's as); it changes semantics only, not size.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Blankslate.Description: a paragraph of muted supporting text.

inputs.name: primaryAction
inputs.description: Blankslate.PrimaryAction: a primary Button, or a primary-styled anchor when href is given.

inputs.name: secondaryAction
inputs.description: Blankslate.SecondaryAction: a Link; its href is required.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: An outer wrapper that is the inline-size query container named blankslate; it fills the width its parent offers.

anatomy.name: Blankslate
anatomy.description: A one-column grid that centres every child horizontally, padded by size; optionally bordered and width-capped.

anatomy.name: Visual
anatomy.description: The icon, in --fgColor-muted, 8px above the heading.

anatomy.name: Heading
anatomy.description: Centred, balanced title text in the size's title shorthand and the inherited foreground colour.

anatomy.name: Description
anatomy.description: A centred, balanced paragraph in the size's body shorthand and --fgColor-muted.

anatomy.name: Action
anatomy.description: A wrapper per action (primary Button, secondary Link), 16px below what precedes it, in the description's type.

variants.description: Heading title-small, description body-medium, 16px padding, visual capped at 24px, small primary Button, 12px under the last action.
Heading title-medium, description body-large, 32px padding, 16px under the last action.
Heading title-large with 8px above it, description body-large with 8px below it, 32px padding, 16px under the last action.
80px block by 40px inline at medium and large; 44px by 28px at small and in a narrow container.

layout.text: The blankslate is a single-column grid that centres each child horizontally; heading and description centre their text and balance their line breaks.
Padding is 32px at medium and large and 16px at small; spacious makes it 80px block by 40px inline at medium and large, 44px by 28px at small.
The heading has 4px below it at every size and 8px above it at large only; the description has 8px below it at large only.
The visual sits 8px above the heading. At small its width is capped at 24px and an SVG inside scales down to fit; at medium and large it keeps its own size.
Each action wrapper is 16px below what precedes it and sets the description's font; the last one has 12px (small) or 16px (medium, large) below it.
narrow caps the width at 485px and centres the block with auto inline margins.

When the outer container is 544px (34rem) wide or less, every size uses title-small for the heading and body-medium for the description; padding becomes 20px (16px at small, 44px by 28px when spacious); the visual is capped at 24px; the first action is 16px below the description, later ones 8px, and the last has 4px below it.

states.text: Static: the visual and description are --fgColor-muted, the heading inherits the surrounding foreground, the border (when on) is --borderColor-default. Actions carry their own Button and Link states.

behaviour.text: The primary action is a primary-variant Button, small when the blankslate is small and medium otherwise (large does not enlarge it); with href it renders as an anchor with the same look.
The secondary action is a Link to href; it has no button form.
Children render in the order given; Blankslate does not reorder visual, heading, description and actions.

keyboard: Not focusable; Tab reaches the primary action, then the secondary link.
Enter activates the actions (Space too for a button primary action).
semantics: The heading is an h2 by default; pick the level that fits the page outline, independent of size.
Blankslate gives the visual no text alternative; treat it as decorative and let the heading carry the meaning.
Nothing is announced when a blankslate replaces content; the caller announces the change if it matters.

notes.text: The compact layout is a CSS container query on the outer wrapper's inline size (544px or less), not on the viewport and not on the narrow-capped inner block. A native build must know the width offered to the blankslate before it picks the heading and description type, since that choice changes their measured heights.
text-wrap: balance evens out line lengths in the heading and description. A native build without it can search for the narrowest width that keeps the same line count, or accept greedy wrapping.

--blankslate-visual-size is set only at small, so at medium and large max-width resolves to none and the visual is as large as the icon the caller passes; only small and the narrow container cap it at 24px.
The heading and description use the font shorthand tokens, which set family, weight, size and line height together; the heading is semibold through the title shorthand, not a separate weight rule.
The last-action spacing keys on :last-of-type, which counts sibling divs: a caller div after the actions moves that margin to it.
The 485px narrow cap and the 34rem (544px) container breakpoint are literals; the CSS comment says 34rem was the small breakpoint when written, which --breakpoint-small still equals.
